title: Palatine Stables

services.name: Full Moon Bike Ride
services.desc: Enjoy a leisurely 10-mile mid-morning ride along Palatine’s scenic paths, visiting local parks and trails. We’ll finish at the Oktoberfest grounds, where you can grab a beer and brat or a spiced cinnamon apple donut from Merck’s. Bring your helmet, appetite, and a bike lock for the post-ride
